_comment: Curated LIST prices for vendors that have no keyless live price feed. Per SINGLE GPU per hour. These are clearly badged 'list' in the dashboard. E2E, JarvisLabs and Yotta Labs are NOT here — they are scraped live from their public pricing pages by scripts/fetch_prices.py. Nebius renders prices client-side (no public feed); AWS/GCP need a (free) credential for their pricing APIs — see README to enable true-live for those. Edit numbers here and bump 'as_of' when you verify them.

providers.note: Per GPU-hour on-demand. Nebius renders prices client-side, so they can't be scraped keyless — verify on nebius.com/prices.
